title: Ordinary continuous scalar pullback preserves the scalar unit
statement: Use the finite continuous coefficient and scheme data of [lem-weil-pbc-realization-completed-pull] and [lem-weil-pbc-realization-scalar-functor]. Let a be a supplied normalized completed-pull arrow over f:T→U, with its ordinary scalar comparison α:F_T P≅P_E F_U, in mathematical composition order, and its coefficient square. Let P be the actual universal ordinary derived pullback, and P_A the exact termwise coefficient-isomorphism pullback of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write e:P≅P_A for canonical left-adjoint uniqueness relative to their common actual derived direct image. Let j_W:id→r_W F_W be the specified scalar-adjunction unit, and b:r_T P_E≅P_A r_U the canonical restriction comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] for those coefficient maps. For every ambient unbounded N in D(A_U), the following equality holds (composition here is left to right): j_T(P(N)) ≫ r_T(α_N) = P(j_U(N)) ≫ e(r_U F_U N) ≫ b⁻¹(F_U N). No constructibility, boundedness or completeness condition is imposed on N. No push comparison or choice of localized-push datum is asserted.

proof.text: At module level apply the normalized actual integral pullback/direct-image Hom bijection. Naturality of its unit and the left-adjoint uniqueness unit equation identify the adjunct of the right side with scalar j_U followed by the rational geometric unit and the identity-on-sections restriction/direct-image comparison. The scalar units send m to 1 tensor m; the actual geometric unit has its specified moduleUnitSection. Therefore the equality of adjuncts is precisely a.module_unit, section by section. The Hom bijection is injective.

proof.text: Left-adjoint uniqueness commutes with passing first to homotopy categories and then to derived adjunctions. For the latter assertion construct the natural map of left-derived functors induced by the ordinary uniqueness map. The derived counit computation and right-derived universality show that this map preserves counits, hence it is the unique adjunction identification. Thus its computation on every complex is the actual ordinary computation counit followed by the termwise ordinary uniqueness map.

proof.text: Fix a complex K. Postcompose both candidate morphisms by restriction of the rational pullback of the scalar computation counit, then the rational pullback computation factor, then the restriction computation factor. This composite is invertible because sU.computes holds on every complex. Use a.derived_normalization and sT.unit on the left. Use naturality, the canonical derived restriction square factorization, the coordinate computation from step 2, and sU.unit on the right. Both results are the actual ordinary counit followed by Q of the two module morphisms in step 1, degree by degree; a.complex_terms identifies the comparison terms. Cancel the invertible composite. Finally the two sides form natural transformations, and essential surjectivity of the complex localization Q proves the identity on every unbounded derived object.

theorem realizationOrdinaryPull_scalarUnit
    (a : RealizationCompletedPullArrow T U f sT sU)
    (N : PbcCompletedDerived U.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (realizationPullScalarMap l E sT)).unit.app
        ((pbcActualDerivedPull f (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj N) ≫
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (realizationPullScalarMap l E sT)).map
        (a.ordinaryComparison.hom.app N) =
    (pbcActualDerivedPull f (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).map
        ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (realizationPullScalarMap l E sU)).unit.app N) ≫
      ((pbcActualDerivedAdjunction f (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).leftAdjointUniq
        (proEtaleRingDerivedAdjunction f _ _
          (@asIso _ _ _ _ (completedCoefficientMap f (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
            a.coefficient_isIso))).hom.app
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict (realizationPullScalarMap l E sU)).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (realizationPullScalarMap l E sU)).obj N)) ≫
      (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f
        (pbcAdicCompletion U.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
        (rationalCoefficientSheaf l U.scheme E)
        (pbcAdicCompletion T.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
        (rationalCoefficientSheaf l T.scheme E)
        (realizationPullScalarMap l E sU) (realizationPullScalarMap l E sT)
        (@asIso _ _ _ _ (completedCoefficientMap f (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
          a.coefficient_isIso) a.rationalCoefficient a.coefficient_square.symm).inv.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (realizationPullScalarMap l E sU)).obj N)

edge_cases: N=0: both sides are zero morphisms.
Identity f: the canonical adjunction coordinate and coefficient restriction maps reduce to the unit equation.
Empty schemes: the zero module categories satisfy the argument; no point or nonzero section is selected.
Torsion N with zero rationalization: both sides vanish after the scalar unit; no scalar unit injectivity is assumed.
Unbounded N: every complex is allowed in sT.unit, sU.unit and a.derived_normalization.
